questions.stem: What is the tax paid directly by the taxpayer called?
questions.solution: Direct tax is the tax paid directly by the taxpayer, as it is levied on the individual or organization and paid directly to the government. Indirect taxes, such as sales or service taxes, are collected by an intermediary and passed on to the government, meaning the taxpayer does not pay them directly.

hi.stem: करदाता द्वारा सीधे भुगतान किया गया कर क्या कहलाता है?
hi.solution: प्रत्यक्ष कर वह कर होता है जो करदाता द्वारा सीधे भुगतान किया जाता है, क्योंकि यह व्यक्ति या संगठन पर लगाया जाता है और सीधे सरकार को भुगतान किया जाता है। अप्रत्यक्ष कर, जैसे बिक्री या सेवा कर, एक मध्यस्थ द्वारा एकत्र किए जाते हैं और सरकार को दे दिए जाते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि करदाता उन्हें सीधे नहीं भुगतान करता है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi terminology used for tax types.

questions.stem: What is the maximum permissible amount under section 80C of income tax?
questions.solution: The maximum permissible amount under section 80C of income tax is 1,50,000 rupees, as this is the legally defined limit for deductions under this section. The other options are incorrect because they do not reflect the actual statutory limit set by the tax regulations.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a direct tax?
questions.solution: Income tax is a direct tax because it is levied directly on an individual's earnings. Unlike indirect taxes, which are collected from consumers through the price of goods and services, income tax is paid directly by the taxpayer to the government. Value added tax, excise duty, and service tax are all indirect taxes as they are embedded in the cost of products and services.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक प्रत्यक्ष कर है?
hi.solution: आय कर एक प्रत्यक्ष कर है क्योंकि यह व्यक्ति की कमाई पर सीधे लगाया जाता है। अप्रत्यक्ष करों के विपरीत, जो वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के मूल्य के माध्यम से उपभोक्ताओं से एकत्र किए जाते हैं, आय कर लेनदार के द्वारा सीधे सरकार को दिया जाता है। मूल्य वर्धित कर, उत्पाद शुल्क और सेवा कर सभी अप्रत्यक्ष कर हैं क्योंकि वे वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की कीमत में एम्बेडेड होते हैं।

questions.stem: If a farmer's income is Rs. 16,800 and his expenditure is Rs. 11,200, what is his saving?
questions.solution: Aman's saving is calculated by subtracting his expenditure from his income. Rs. 16,800 - Rs. 11,200 = Rs. 5,600. The other options do not match the calculation.

hi.stem: यदि एक किसान की आय 16,800 रुपये है और उसका व्यय 11,200 रुपये है, तो उसकी बचत क्या है?
hi.solution: अमन की बचत उसकी आय में से व्यय को घटाकर निकाली जाती है। 16,800 रुपये - 11,200 रुपये = 5,600 रुपये। अन्य विकल्प हिसाब के अनुरूप नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate terminology.

mr.stem: एका शेतकऱ्याच्या उत्पन्नाचे 16,800 रु. आहे आणि त्याचा खर्च 11,200 रु. आहे, तर त्याचे बचत किती आहे?
mr.solution: अमनची बचत त्याच्या उत्पन्नातून खर्च वजा करून काढली जाते. 16,800 रु. - 11,200 रु. = 5,600 रु. इतर विकल्प गणनेशी जुळत नाहीत.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi terminology for financial concepts like 'उत्पन्न' (income), 'खर्च' (expenditure), and 'बचत' (savings).

questions.stem: If a person's gross total income is ₹12,00,000 and they have saved ₹1,50,000 under section 80C, what is their taxable income?
questions.solution: Taxable income is calculated by subtracting permissible deductions from the gross total income. In this case, ₹12,00,000 - ₹1,50,000 = ₹10,50,000. The other options either add or do not correctly subtract the deduction.

questions.stem: Mr. Mehta's annual income is Rs. 4,50,000. He does not have any deductions. Which income tax slab does his taxable income fall into?

The option 'Up to 2,50,000' is incorrect because his income is higher. The option '5,00,001 to 10,00,000' is incorrect because his income is lower. questions.stem: If Anil's monthly income is Rs. 9,600 and he saves Rs. 1,920, what percentage of his income does he save?
